definitions.explanation: Overseeing and checking the content of a publication, program, or project to ensure accuracy and quality. The person who does this is the {監修者|かんしゅうしゃ}.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{監修|かんしゅう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This book was supervised by an expert.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦シェフ→シェフ：05062_shefu⟧{監修|かんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{登場|とうじょう}→登場：13625_toujou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A menu supervised by a famous chef appeared.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{監修|かんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}{食品|しょくひん}→健康食品：17355_kenkoushokuhin⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{安心|あんしん}して→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧⟦{食|た}べられる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Since the health food was made under the supervision of a doctor, you can eat it with confidence.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both as a suru verb ({監修|かんしゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, to supervise) and as a noun modifier ({監修|かんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧). Very common in publishing, media, and product marketing to indicate expert oversight. Often seen on book covers and food packaging: 〇〇{監修|かんしゅう} (supervised by 〇〇).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧{監修|かんしゅう}: supervised by a doctor
- {監修者|かんしゅうしゃ}: supervisor, editorial supervisor
- {監修|かんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: under the supervision of
- ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{監修|かんしゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: ~ supervises

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{慣習|かんしゅう}→慣習：05523_kanshuu⟧: custom, convention (different meaning)
